local: Yumi, yumi, yumi i glat long talem se
Yumi, yumi, yumi ol man blong [[Vanuatu]]
God i givim ples ia long yumi,
english: We are, we are, we are happy to proclaim
We are, we are, we are the people of [[Vanuatu]]
God has given us this land,

local: Yumi strong mo yumi fri long hem,
Plante fasin blong bifo i stap,
english: We are strong and we are free in this land,

local: Be yumi i olsem wan nomo,
Yumi save plante wok i stap,
english: And this is who we are.
We know there is much work to be done,
God helps us in our work,
